title: Everyday Phrases — Asking the Cabin Crew
title_quote: May I get a blanket, please?
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】✈️ 實用「機艙求助」必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Asking the Cabin Crew
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用「機艙求助」情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫）。場景是空服員：一趟夜班飛機：起飛後要毯子和枕頭、請空服員調椅背，要水與點心、問耳機怎麼用，遇到亂流時繫好安全帶、要了暈機藥，降落前收桌板、問轉機與行李，下機時跟空服員道謝。400 句循環聽，A2 程度，零基礎也能跟著開口說。#英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical 'Asking the Cabin Crew' phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue). On a night flight: asking for a blanket and pillow, learning how the headset works, buckling up through turbulence, asking about a connecting flight, and thanking the crew on the way out. 400 lines on repeat, A2 level.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I get a blanket, please?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, I will bring one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I also have a pillow?
dialogue.zh: 我也可以要一個枕頭嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here is a clean pillow.
dialogue.zh: 這裡有一個乾淨的枕頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two blankets would be nice.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I will bring two.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this blanket warm enough?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is quite warm.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where are the spare pillows?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They are above your spot.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My pillow fell on the floor.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will get another one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have thicker blankets?
dialogue.zh: 你們有比較厚的毯子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We have thicker ones here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would you open my air vent?
dialogue.zh: 可以幫我打開我的通風口嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, I will turn it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This pillow is a bit flat.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me swap it for you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I keep this blanket?
dialogue.zh: 這條毯子我可以留著嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You may keep it tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are there pillows in the bin?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, that bin is empty.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please bring me one more blanket.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will bring it right away.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I recline in my spot?
dialogue.zh: 我可以在我的位子往後躺嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the light is off.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How far does this chair lean?
dialogue.zh: 這張椅子可以往後多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It goes back a little.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My recline button is stuck.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me try pressing it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I lean my seat back?
dialogue.zh: 我可以把椅背往後靠嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but not during meals.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would you help with my seat?
dialogue.zh: 可以幫我看看我的椅子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, show me the seat.
dialogue.zh: 當然，指給我看是哪個座位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is this chair so stiff?
dialogue.zh: 這張椅子為什麼這麼硬？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It may need a small push.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could I put my seat upright?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, please pull it forward.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who can fix this seat?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our engineer can check it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My seat back is very loose.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will report it later.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I recline just a little?
dialogue.zh: 我是不是只倒一點點就好？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that is more polite.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to sit up?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet, we are climbing.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The row behind mine is tight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will check that row.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could I move to another place?
dialogue.zh: 我可以換到別的位置嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The place by the window is free.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə pleɪs baɪ ðə ˈwɪndoʊ ɪz fri./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Someone keeps kicking where I sit.
dialogue.zh: 有人一直踢我坐的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me talk to them.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The child behind keeps kicking.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We will ask them to stop.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would you ask him to stop?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Certainly, I will do that.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My seat shakes with every kick.
dialogue.zh: 每踢一下我的椅子就震一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That must be very annoying.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would you move me somewhere else?
dialogue.zh: 可以幫我換到別的位置嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is an empty row.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are there any other free spots?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is one near the window.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please tell them to stop kicking.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We will remind them now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This kicking is really too much.
dialogue.zh: 這樣一直踢實在太過分了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me find you a free spot.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi faɪnd ju ə fri spɑt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The air conditioning feels too cold.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can lower that vent.
dialogue.zh: 我們可以把那個通風口關小。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the cabin always feel cold?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The cabin warms after takeoff.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hands are freezing right now.
dialogue.zh: 我的手現在凍得不得了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A warm drink may help.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I get a hot tea?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, coming right up.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The cold air hits my neck.
dialogue.zh: 冷風一直吹到我的脖子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That vent can be closed.
dialogue.zh: 那個通風口可以關起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have any warm blankets?
dialogue.zh: 你們有暖一點的毯子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There are a few left.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I close this vent?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just twist it to the left.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the blanket cost anything?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it is always free.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please bring a warm blanket soon.
dialogue.zh: 請快點拿一條暖毯子來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your blanket is coming now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This blanket feels much better.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is good to hear.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This spot is comfortable now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rest well during the flight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the pillows still available?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There are two left here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks for the blanket and pillow.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are very welcome.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I call if I need more?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ kɔl ɪf aɪ nid mɔr?/
dialogue.zh: 如果還需要，我可以叫你嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just press the blue button.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The cabin is warmer after all.
dialogue.zh: 機艙最後還是暖起來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The crew adjusted the air.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you show me the light?
dialogue.zh: 可以指給我看燈在哪嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The light is above you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does my seat look fine now?
dialogue.zh: 我的位子現在看起來沒問題吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That looks perfect to me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could I have some water please?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, still or sparkling water?
dialogue.zh: 好的，要一般水還是氣泡水？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could I have some hot tea?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, with milk or sugar?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will the meal service start soon?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, they are coming down now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What snacks do you have today?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We have pretzels and small cookies.
dialogue.zh: 我們有蝴蝶餅和小餅乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which meal is left on the cart?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ mil ɪz lɛft ɑn ðə kɑrt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only the chicken rice is left.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have a vegetarian option?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry, it ran out this morning.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could I get some orange juice?
dialogue.zh: 我可以要一些柳橙汁嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, here is your orange juice.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I have another cup please?
dialogue.zh: 請問我可以再要一杯嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Certainly, I will bring one over.
dialogue.zh: 當然，我幫您送一杯過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this water bottle sealed?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it is still sealed.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much is the snack box?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is free on this flight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where can I find more napkins?
dialogue.zh: 我可以在哪裡拿到更多紙巾？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They are in the back galley.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have hot chocolate today?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, but we have hot tea.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could I have two packs of cookies?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd aɪ hæv tu pæks əv ˈkʊkiz/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, here are two packs.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the coffee decaf or regular?
dialogue.zh: 咖啡是低咖啡因還是正常的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both, which one do you want?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could you fill my bottle with water?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd ju fɪl maɪ ˈbɑtəl wɪð ˈwɔtər?/
dialogue.zh: 你可以幫我把瓶子裝滿水嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, give me a moment.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What drinks are available right now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We have cola, juice and water.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My tray table is a bit sticky.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ treɪ ˈteɪbəl ɪz ə bɪt ˈstɪki./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will wipe it for you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sorry, I dropped my fork.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No problem, here is a new one.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈprɑbləm hɪr ɪz ə nu wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，這裡有一支新的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any snacks for my child, please?
dialogue.zh: 請問有給我小孩的點心嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I will bring a small one.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs aɪ wɪl brɪŋ ə smɔl wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 有的，我送一份小份的過來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which sandwich do you recommend?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The ham and cheese is popular.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could I have some more ice?
dialogue.zh: 我可以再要一些冰塊嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, here you are.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the snacks free of charge?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, they are all free.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you still have any pasta?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, only the chicken is left.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks for the extra cookies.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, anytime.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, may I have water?
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，我可以要水嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, I will get one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, how do these headphones work?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuz mi haʊ du ðiz ˈhɛdfoʊnz wɜrk?/
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，這些耳機要怎麼用？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just plug them into the armrest.
dialogue.zh: 把它們插進扶手就可以了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I plug in the headphones?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du aɪ plʌɡ ɪn ðə ˈhɛdfoʊnz?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The socket is beside your seat.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My screen is not turning on.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me check the power button.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I change the language?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Press the menu button, then settings.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What movies are playing on this flight?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ˈmuviz ɑr ˈpleɪɪŋ ɑn ðɪs flaɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 這班飛機上在播什麼電影？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There are three new movies today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which button starts the movie?
dialogue.zh: 哪個按鍵可以開始播放電影？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The green play button on screen.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would you show me the volume control?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊd ju ʃoʊ mi ðə ˈvɑljum kənˈtroʊl/
dialogue.zh: 你可以指給我看音量控制嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it is on your armrest.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would you help me with this screen?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊd ju hɛlp mi wɪð ðɪs skrin?/
dialogue.zh: 你可以幫我看一下這個螢幕嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, what is the problem?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This headphone has no sound.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me try another headphone.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are there channels for children?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, channel six has cartoons.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is the screen frozen now?
dialogue.zh: 螢幕為什麼現在卡住了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It restarts in a few seconds.
dialogue.zh: 它幾秒後就會重新啟動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I pay for the headphones?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, they are free for you.
dialogue.zh: 不用，您的耳機是免費的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have a longer cable?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will look in the galley.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you sell headphones on board?
dialogue.zh: 你們在機上有賣耳機嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but we also lend them.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That screen keeps showing an error.
dialogue.zh: 那個螢幕一直顯示錯誤。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will reset your seat screen.
dialogue.zh: 我幫您重新設定座位的螢幕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will the movie start again soon?
dialogue.zh: 電影會很快重新開始嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, in about one minute.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How can I pause the film?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Press the red button twice.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is no sound in my earphones.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz noʊ saʊnd ɪn maɪ ˈɪrfoʊnz./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe the plug is not tight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please turn up the volume a little.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz tɜrn ʌp ðə ˈvɑljum ə ˈlɪtəl./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, is this level better?
dialogue.zh: 好的，這樣的大小可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any idea why the screen is dark?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛni aɪˈdiə waɪ ðə skrin ɪz dɑrk?/
dialogue.zh: 你知道螢幕為什麼是黑的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The crew turned off the system.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sorry, my headphone fell on the floor.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑri maɪ ˈhɛdfoʊn fɛl ɑn ðə flɔr./
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，我的耳機掉在地上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will get you a clean one.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl ɡɛt ju ə klin wʌn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks, the new screen works well.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，新螢幕用起來沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, enjoy your movie now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When will the meal service end?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It ends in about twenty minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which dessert is still available?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only the fruit cup is left.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I have more water, please?
dialogue.zh: 請問我可以再要一些水嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, I will bring a bottle.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The plane is shaking a lot now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə pleɪn ɪz ˈʃeɪkɪŋ ə lɑt naʊ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is just some rough air.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this normal or very dangerous?
dialogue.zh: 這是正常的還是很危險？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is normal, so stay calm.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are we flying through a storm?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We are only passing some clouds.
dialogue.zh: 我們只是穿過一些雲層。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the captain say something to us?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ðə ˈkæptɪn seɪ ˈsʌmθɪŋ tu ʌs?/
dialogue.zh: 機長有對我們說什麼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He asked everyone to sit down.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to fasten my seatbelt?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid tu ˈfæsən maɪ ˈsitbɛlt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, please buckle it right now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I stay in my seat?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You should stay seated until we land.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ʃʊd steɪ ˈsitɪd ʌnˈtɪl wi lænd./
dialogue.zh: 你應該坐好直到我們降落。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I go to the bathroom?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not now, the air is rough.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is the buckle on this belt?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ɪz ðə ˈbʌkəl ɑn ðɪs bɛlt?/
dialogue.zh: 這條安全帶的扣環在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is the metal part in front.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ðə ˈmɛtəl pɑrt ɪn frʌnt./
dialogue.zh: 就是前面那個金屬的部分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is my seat belt tight enough?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It looks fine, but pull once more.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt lʊks faɪn bʌt pʊl wʌns mɔr./
dialogue.zh: 看起來沒問題，再拉一次就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My seat belt is stuck, won't move.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ sit bɛlt ɪz stʌk, woʊnt muv./
dialogue.zh: 我的安全帶卡住，拉不動。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, let me take it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where does my tray go?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please close it and lock the latch.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz kloʊz ɪt ænd lɑk ðə lætʃ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is my seat back in place?
dialogue.zh: 我的椅背在正確的位置嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it is straight up now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long will this shaking last?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It should stop in a few minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ʃʊd stɑp ɪn ə fju ˈmɪnɪts./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you feel that big drop?
dialogue.zh: 你有感覺到那一下大降落嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it woke up some passengers.
dialogue.zh: 有，它把一些乘客弄醒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I feel very sick from the motion.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ fil ˈvɛri sɪk frʌm ðə ˈmoʊʃən./
dialogue.zh: 我因為晃動覺得很想吐。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can bring you some medicine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have medicine for air sickness?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju hæv ˈmɛdəsɪn fər ɛr ˈsɪknəs?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we keep some in the galley.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wi kip sʌm ɪn ðə ˈgæli./
dialogue.zh: 有，我們在廚房區放了一些。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That pill helped me a lot.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am glad you feel better.
dialogue.zh: 很高興你覺得好一點了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a bag for throwing up?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ə bæɡ fər ˈθroʊɪŋ ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 我會拿到一個嘔吐袋嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is one inside your seat pocket.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz wʌn ɪnˈsaɪd jʊr sit ˈpɑkɪt./
dialogue.zh: 你的座椅口袋裡就有一個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could I have a cup of water?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd aɪ hæv ə kʌp əv ˈwɔtər?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, I will bring it soon.
dialogue.phonetic: /əv kɔrs aɪ wɪl brɪŋ ɪt sun./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would you like a cold towel?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that would help my face.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who can help me with this problem?
dialogue.phonetic: /hu kæn hɛlp mi wɪð ðɪs ˈprɑbləm?/
dialogue.zh: 誰能幫我處理這個問題？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am the crew for this section.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm ðə kru fɔr ðɪs ˈsɛkʃən./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could you hold my bag for me?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd ju hoʊld maɪ bæg fɔr mi?/
dialogue.zh: 你可以幫我拿一下袋子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will keep it by my feet.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl kip ɪt baɪ maɪ fit/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you turn the light off?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It warns people to buckle up.
dialogue.zh: 它是在提醒大家扣好安全帶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could I get my child a blanket?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd aɪ ɡɛt maɪ tʃaɪld ə ˈblæŋkɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以給我的小孩一條毯子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will find one for you now.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl faɪnd wʌn fɔr ju naʊ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks for staying with us here.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你留在這裡陪我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are welcome, it is my job.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɑr ˈwɛlkəm ɪt ɪz maɪ dʒɑb./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Was that bump just a small one?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌz ðæt bʌmp dʒʌst ə smɔl wʌn?/
dialogue.zh: 剛才那一下只是小顛簸嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It was small, so do not worry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt wʌz smɔl soʊ du nɑt ˈwɜri./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Have you seen worse air than this?
dialogue.phonetic: /hæv ju sin wɜrs ɛr ðæn ðɪs?/
dialogue.zh: 你見過比這更糟的亂流嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but this one is mild.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I safely drink my tea now?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ ˈseɪfli drɪŋk maɪ ti naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 我現在喝我的茶安全嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please wait until the shaking stops.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should my child wear a belt too?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd maɪ tʃaɪld wɛr ə bɛlt tu?/
dialogue.zh: 我的小孩也要繫安全帶嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, every person needs one now.
dialogue.zh: 要，現在每個人都需要繫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the belt fit over my coat?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə bɛlt fɪt ˈoʊvər maɪ koʊt?/
dialogue.zh: 安全帶能扣在我的外套外面嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, just keep it low and tight.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs dʒʌst kip ɪt loʊ ænd taɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I move to another empty seat?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ muv tu əˈnʌðər ˈɛmpti sit?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以換到另一個空位嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please stay put during the turbulence.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have pills for dizziness?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We have some, please wait a moment.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi hæv sʌm pliz weɪt ə ˈmoʊmənt./
dialogue.zh: 我們有一些，請稍等一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many pills should I take?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only one, with a little water.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will the medicine make me sleepy?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It may, so rest your eyes.
dialogue.zh: 可能會，所以閉眼休息吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I take it with my medicine?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ teɪk ɪt wɪð maɪ ˈmɛdəsɪn/
dialogue.zh: 我可以和我自己的藥一起吃嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please ask a doctor about that.
dialogue.zh: 這件事請教醫生比較好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I think I am going to vomit.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ θɪŋk aɪ æm ˈgoʊɪŋ tu ˈvɑmɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Breathe slowly and use this bag.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the bathroom open right now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, please wait a few minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could you bring me a warm drink?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd ju brɪŋ mi ə wɔrm drɪŋk?/
dialogue.zh: 你可以拿一杯熱飲給我嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tea or coffee, what do you want?
dialogue.phonetic: /ti ɔr ˈkɔfi wʌt du ju wɑnt/
dialogue.zh: 茶還是咖啡，你要哪一種？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would it help if I lie down?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊd ɪt hɛlp ɪf aɪ laɪ daʊn?/
dialogue.zh: 如果我躺下來會有幫助嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, lean back and close your eyes.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs lin bæk ænd kloʊz jʊr aɪz./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have a cold cloth?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here is one for your forehead.
dialogue.zh: 這裡有一條，給你敷額頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I ask you for a favor?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ æsk ju fɔr ə ˈfeɪvər?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, tell me what you need.
dialogue.zh: 當然，告訴我你需要什麼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could you call a doctor for me?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd ju kɔl ə ˈdɑktər fɔr mi?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will call one on the ground.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl kɔl wʌn ɑn ðə graʊnd./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a nurse on this flight?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ə nɜrs ɑn ðɪs flaɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 這班飛機上有護理師嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, two passengers are nurses.
dialogue.zh: 有，有兩位乘客是護理師。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where can I put my hot cup?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr kæn aɪ pʊt maɪ hɑt kʌp?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give it to me, I'll hold it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɪv ɪt tu mi, aɪl hoʊld ɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the aisles closed for now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, everyone must remain seated.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When will the seatbelt sign go off?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛn wɪl ðə ˈsitbɛlt saɪn goʊ ɔf?/
dialogue.zh: 安全帶指示燈什麼時候會熄？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soon, when the air becomes smooth.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I use my laptop during this?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ juz maɪ ˈlæpˌtɑp ˈdʊrɪŋ ðɪs?/
dialogue.zh: 這段時間我可以用筆電嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not now, please put it away.
dialogue.zh: 現在不行，請把它收起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shall I help with your bags?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No thanks, but please stay seated.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks for checking on me twice.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, tell me if you need more.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr, tɛl mi ɪf ju nid mɔr./
dialogue.zh: 當然，需要更多就告訴我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The air feels calmer for now.
dialogue.zh: 現在氣流感覺平穩多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, you may relax a little.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are we landing soon?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In about twenty minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When should I put my seat up?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛn ʃʊd aɪ pʊt maɪ sit ʌp?/
dialogue.zh: 我什麼時候要把椅背調直？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please put it up right now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I close my tray table?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please close it and lock it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is my connecting gate?
dialogue.zh: 我的轉機登機門在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is on your boarding pass.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long is my layover?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You have about two hours.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will my bag go to Taipei?
dialogue.zh: 我的行李會直掛到台北嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is checked through.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I get my bag back here?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ ɡɛt maɪ bæɡ bæk hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 我可以在這裡拿回行李嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You pick it up after landing.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to go through security?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid tu ɡoʊ θru sɪˈkjʊrəti?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You must pass security once more.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the airport big?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please walk quickly to your gate.
dialogue.zh: 請快步前往你的登機門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What time do we arrive?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We arrive at six thirty.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will you help with my overhead bag?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ju hɛlp wɪð maɪ ˈoʊvərˌhɛd bæɡ/
dialogue.zh: 你能幫我拿上面的行李嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, but please wait till landing.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I claim my suitcase?
dialogue.zh: 我要去哪裡提領行李箱？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At the baggage claim downstairs.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which belt is for this flight?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please check the screen inside.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I keep my laptop out?
dialogue.zh: 我可以把筆電留在外面嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, please stow it now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I fasten my seat belt?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep it on until we stop.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will the weather in Taipei be bad?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ðə ˈwɛðɚ ɪn ˌtaɪˈpeɪ bi bæd?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is rainy but not windy.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I find my next gate?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du aɪ faɪnd maɪ nɛkst ɡeɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 我要怎麼找到下一個登機門？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Follow the signs to transfers.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would you throw this cup away?
dialogue.zh: 你能幫我丟掉這個杯子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, give it to me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is the immigration form?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will bring you one now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I fill this in English?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please use blue or black ink.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can my child stay seated?
dialogue.zh: 我的孩子可以繼續坐著嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but keep the belt on.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the restrooms closed now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We are landing very soon.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where can I get my coat?
dialogue.zh: 我要去哪裡拿我的外套？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is in the closet near you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ɪn ðə ˈklɑzɪt nɪr ju/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks for all your help today.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你今天所有的幫忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are welcome, enjoy your trip.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I borrow a pen from you?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ ˈbɑroʊ ə pɛn frəm ju/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, here is one for you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I recline my seat again?
dialogue.zh: 我可以再把椅背往後倒嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet, we are still landing.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When can I stand up?
dialogue.zh: 我什麼時候可以站起來？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: After the plane stops completely.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is my transfer gate far?
dialogue.zh: 我的轉機登機門很遠嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is a short walk away.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I get to terminal two?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du aɪ ɡɛt tu ˈtɜrmɪnəl tu?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take the train after immigration.
dialogue.zh: 過完入境檢查後搭電車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will someone meet me there?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our staff will wait outside.
dialogue.zh: 我們的同仁會在外面等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I keep this claim tag?
dialogue.zh: 我該留著這張行李存根嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep it with your passport.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I pick up my stroller?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du aɪ pɪk ʌp maɪ ˈstroʊlər?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It comes out with the bags.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you check my seat number?
dialogue.zh: 你能確認一下我的座位號碼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it is on your ticket.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we need to hurry?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, you have plenty of time.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How soon do we land?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In about ten minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who takes the immigration form?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give it to the desk officer.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I move to an empty row?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ muv tu ən ˈɛmpti roʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以換到空排的座位嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not now, please stay seated.
dialogue.zh: 現在不行，請留在座位上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are there any forms for my son?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðɛr ˈɛni fɔrmz fɔr maɪ sʌn?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one form for each person.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why are the lights so bright?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We turn them on before landing.
dialogue.zh: 我們在降落前會把燈打開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to show my passport?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid tu ʃoʊ maɪ ˈpæspɔrt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Have it ready at the gate.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is the transfer desk?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is right after the gate.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is my suitcase too heavy?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it is under the limit.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I buy water after landing?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, there are shops inside.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I wake my wife now?
dialogue.zh: 我現在該叫醒我太太嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we land in ten minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where does the bus stop?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At the door on your left.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could I get an airport map?
dialogue.zh: 我可以拿一份機場地圖嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I will print you one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you open the overhead bin?
dialogue.zh: 你能打開上面的行李艙嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but after we park.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you for the warm blanket.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It was my pleasure, good night.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Have a nice day, goodbye.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Goodbye, and take care.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is my coat still in the closet?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz maɪ koʊt stɪl ɪn ðə ˈklɑzɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 我的外套還在衣櫃裡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I will get it now.

issues.note: 「Do I fill this in English?」被答成「Please use blue or black ink.」——問語言、答墨水，b 未接住 a 的訴求點；屬答非所問，但不在「空心回應／WH 被 Yes-No 答／設定矛盾／結尾未收束」四項 error 判據內，故不判 error。
「Is the airport big?」被答成「Please walk quickly to your gate.」——未回應問句，輕微脫節；同樣非 error 級。
「Can you turn the light off?」由「It warns people to buckle up.」間接婉拒（安全帶燈不由客艙員關），語意可懂但沒明說 No，略突兀；非 error 級。
58–61 連續兩對同一訴求（換位），b 的「There is an empty row.」「There is one near the window.」近似重複，屬輕度原地打轉。
394–397 連續兩對告別（good night／goodbye／take care），398–399 又續問外套；末對本身是請求→完成，閉環良好，僅次序略鬆。

review.summary_zh: 本輪讀到的即為最新視圖：母題稀釋已生效——第 1 段 seat 實測約 8 次（030/032/036/038/040/056/098 等），其餘改用 spot／place／row／chair／where I sit；第 4 段 b 句 Yes/No 起句實測 16/50＝32%。夜航→毯枕→餐飲→耳機螢幕→亂流暈機藥→降落收桌板→轉機行李情境連貫、無設定矛盾（毯子免費、6:30 抵達、轉機兩小時、行李直掛台北一致），末對以取外套收束。僅餘 338/316 兩處答非所問與 58–61 近似重複等非 error 級瑕疵，故 APPROVED，88 分。
